verifications.claim: Human landing on the Moon with the Artemis program is currently scheduled for the Artemis III mission.
verifications.label: AMBIGUOUS
verifications.evidence: R1: 'The Artemis III landing, set to take place in 2025'; R2: 'Artemis III, currently planned for 2027, will mark humanity’s first return to the lunar surface'; R5: 'Artemis III (mid-2027) ... Crewed test of HLS in low Earth orbit ... The first lunar landing of the program is planned for the Artemis IV mission'; R6: 'Artemis IV mission, planned for 2028'; R7: 'Artemis IV is scheduled to be the first crewed mission to the lunar surface'
verifications.reasoning: Some sources (R1, R2) support Artemis III as landing mission; others (R5, R6, R7) state Artemis IV is first landing, contradicting claim.

verifications.claim: The Artemis III mission is aimed for 2027.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'Artemis III, currently planned for 2027'; R5: 'Artemis III (mid-2027)'; R6: 'Artemis III, in 2027'; R7: 'The mission is currently scheduled for 2027'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly confirm 2027 target for Artemis III.

verifications.claim: The Artemis III mission will mark the first crewed lunar landing since 1972.
verifications.label: AMBIGUOUS
verifications.evidence: R1: 'the first woman on the moon ... unlike any mission that's come before'; R2: 'will mark humanity’s first return to the lunar surface in more than 50 years'; R5: 'Artemis IV ... first American crewed lunar landing since Apollo 17 in December 1972'; R6: 'future human landing for the first time since the 1960s'; R7: 'Artemis IV ... first crewed mission to the lunar surface since the Apollo era'
verifications.reasoning: R1 and R2 support Artemis III as first landing; R5-R7 attribute first landing to Artemis IV.

verifications.claim: The Artemis III mission focuses on the lunar South Pole.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R1: 'All 13 sites are near the lunar South Pole ... The Artemis III lunar mission will be looking to collect samples and study the water ice at the moon's South Pole'; R2: 'sending the first humans to explore the region near the lunar South Pole'
verifications.reasoning: R1 and R2 describe South Pole focus assuming landing, but recent sources indicate no landing for III, making support broader/less precise.

verifications.claim: Another crewed landing following Artemis III is planned for 2028 under the Artemis IV mission.
verifications.label: AMBIGUOUS
verifications.evidence: R5: 'Artemis IV (early 2028) ... first lunar landing'; R6: 'Artemis IV mission, planned for 2028 [landing]'; R7: 'Artemis IV is scheduled ... 2028 launch [first crewed mission to the lunar surface]'
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm Artemis IV landing in 2028 as first (not following III), contradicting 'another'; no source supports III as prior landing.

verifications.claim: Artemis II completed a crewed flyby of the Moon.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'flying aboard NASA’s Orion spacecraft around the Moon'; R4: 'approached Earth at 147,337 miles [post-flyby]'; R5: 'Artemis II ... lunar flyby'; R6: 'historic lunar fly-by'
verifications.reasoning: All relevant sources directly confirm crewed lunar flyby completion.

verifications.claim: Artemis II had a splashdown on April 10, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'NASA’s Artemis II mission is scheduled to splash down ... on Friday, April 10'; R4: 'splashdown around 8:07 p.m. ... Friday, April 10'; R6: 'splashdown ... on Friday 10 April'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources precisely match date and event.

verifications.claim: Artemis III is planned to be the first crewed landing on the lunar surface.
verifications.label: AMBIGUOUS
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Artemis III lunar mission will be looking to ... land'; R2: 'first return to the lunar surface'; R5: 'Artemis IV ... first crewed lunar landing since Apollo 17'; R6/R7: Artemis IV first landing
verifications.reasoning: Contradictory: R1/R2 support III as first landing; R5-R7 state IV.

verifications.claim: Artemis III will utilize SpaceX's Starship or Blue Origin's lander.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'NASA has selected SpaceX to provide the human landing system ... Starship'; R5: 'rendezvous ... with one or both ... SpaceX's Starship HLS and Blue Origin's Blue Moon'; R7: 'test integration with commercial lunar landers from SpaceX and Blue Origin'
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly confirm use of Starship HLS and/or Blue Moon for Artemis III.

verifications.claim: Artemis IV is scheduled as the second crewed landing mission to continue building a sustainable presence.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R5: 'Artemis IV (early 2028) ... first lunar landing ... Artemis V (late 2028) ... second crewed lunar landing'; R6: 'Artemis IV finally flies [first landing] ... another landing later in 2028 with the Artemis V mission'
verifications.reasoning: Sources describe Artemis IV as first (not second) crewed landing; V as second.
